command: $names='docker','podman','nerdctl','wsl','mariadbd','mysqld','redis-server'; $names | ForEach-Object { $c=Get-Command $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [pscustomobject]@{name=$_;paths=@($c.Source)} } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4; Get-Service | Where-Object {$_.Name -match 'docker|podman|maria|mysql|redis|wsl|lxss'} | Select-Object Name,Status,DisplayName | ConvertTo-Json; Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.LocalPort -in 13306,16379,2375,2376,3306,6379} | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | ConvertTo-Json
